description: Voice Recording & Transcription - Record user voice during meetings, transcribe with Whisper API, integrate with AI analysis

userStories.title: Create recordings database table
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store recording metadata and transcriptions in SQLite so they persist across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'recordings' table to DatabaseService with columns: id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), date (TEXT), startTime (TEXT), endTime (TEXT), duration (REAL), audioFilePath (TEXT nullable), transcription (TEXT nullable), transcriptionStatus (TEXT: pending/processing/completed/failed), errorMessage (TEXT nullable), createdAt (TEXT)
Add createRecording() method that inserts a new recording
Add updateRecording() method that updates existing recording by id
Add getRecordingsForDate(date:) method that returns all recordings for a specific date
Add getRecordingById(id:) method that returns a single recording
Add deleteRecording(id:) method that removes a recording
Table created on app launch if not exists
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add microphone permission handling
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear guidance when microphone permission is needed so that I can grant access.
acceptanceCriteria: Create MicrophonePermissionService singleton
Add checkPermissionStatus() method returning: authorized/denied/notDetermined
Add requestPermission() async method that triggers system permission dialog
Add openSystemPreferences() method that opens System Preferences > Privacy > Microphone
Permission check called before any recording attempt
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Implement basic voice recording service
userStories.description: As a user, I want to record my voice using my Mac's microphone so that I can capture what I say.
acceptanceCriteria: Create VoiceRecordingService singleton using AVFoundation
Add startRecording() method that begins microphone capture
Add stopRecording() method that finalizes and saves audio file
Configure AVAudioRecorder for M4A format (AAC codec, 44100Hz, mono)
Audio files saved to ~/Library/Application Support/EnglishAI/recordings/
Filename format: recording_[timestamp].m4a
Create recordings directory if not exists
Expose isRecording published property for UI binding
Expose currentDuration published property (updates every second while recording)
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add recording duration constraints
userStories.description: As a user, I want recording time limits enforced so I don't record too short or too long.
acceptanceCriteria: Minimum recording duration: 10 seconds (stopRecording ignored if under 10s)
Maximum recording duration: 1 hour (3600 seconds)
Auto-stop recording when 1 hour limit reached
Expose canStop published property (true when duration >= 10s)
Expose timeRemaining published property (seconds until 1hr limit)
Post notification when auto-stopped at limit
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Implement Whisper API transcription service
userStories.description: As a user, I want my recordings transcribed to text using OpenAI Whisper API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create WhisperTranscriptionService singleton
Add transcribe(audioFilePath:) async method that calls OpenAI API
Use endpoint: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions
Set model parameter to 'whisper-1'
Set language parameter to 'en' (English)
Use existing OpenAI API key from SettingsService
Return transcription text on success
Throw descriptive error on failure (network, API error, etc)
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Handle large audio files with chunking
userStories.description: As a user, I want long recordings transcribed even if they exceed the 25MB API limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Check file size before API call
If file > 25MB, split audio using AVAssetExportSession
Create chunks of approximately 20MB each
Transcribe each chunk sequentially
Concatenate chunk transcriptions with space separator
Clean up temporary chunk files after transcription
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add Recordings tab to main navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated Recordings tab so I can access voice recording features.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Recordings' tab to main ContentView navigation
Create RecordingsView as the tab content
Tab uses microphone SF Symbol icon
Tab positioned after existing tabs
Consistent styling with existing app tabs
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add date navigation to Recordings tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate between days to see recordings from specific dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Add date picker to RecordingsView header (match existing date navigation style)
Display selected date prominently
Add previous/next day navigation arrows
Default to current day on tab open
Fetch and display recordings for selected date
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add recording start/stop controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want start/stop buttons so I can control when recording happens.
acceptanceCriteria: Large 'Start Recording' button when not recording (green, microphone icon)
Button changes to 'Stop Recording' when recording (red, stop icon)
Display elapsed time timer in MM:SS format during recording
Show pulsing red dot indicator when recording
Stop button disabled during first 10 seconds (show countdown)
Show remaining time until 1-hour limit
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add stop recording confirmation dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want a confirmation dialog before stopping so I don't accidentally lose my recording.
acceptanceCriteria: Show confirmation alert when user taps Stop Recording
Alert title: 'Stop Recording?'
Alert message shows recording duration
Two buttons: 'Cancel' (continue recording) and 'Stop & Transcribe'
Dialog does NOT appear when auto-stopped at 1-hour limit
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add menu bar recording indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see recording status in the menu bar when the app is in the background.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or extend NSStatusItem for menu bar
Show red dot overlay on menu bar icon when recording
Menu bar menu shows 'Recording...' with elapsed time when active
Add 'Stop Recording' menu item that triggers stop (with confirmation)
Revert to normal icon when recording stops
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Auto-transcribe when recording stops
userStories.description: As a user, I want transcription to start automatically when I stop recording.
acceptanceCriteria: After user confirms stop, create database record with status 'processing'
Immediately call WhisperTranscriptionService.transcribe()
Show 'Transcribing...' status with spinner in UI
On success: update record with transcription text, set status 'completed'
On failure: update record with error message, set status 'failed'
Show success/failure notification to user
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Display recordings list with transcriptions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recordings and their transcriptions for the selected day.
acceptanceCriteria: List all recordings for selected date below the recording controls
Each row shows: time, duration, status badge (pending/processing/completed/failed)
Completed recordings show transcription preview (first 100 chars)
Clicking a row expands to show full transcription
Add 'Copy' button that copies transcription to clipboard
Show empty state message when no recordings for the day
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Add manual retry for failed transcriptions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to retry failed transcriptions so I can recover from temporary errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Show 'Retry' button on recordings with 'failed' status
Retry button only visible if audioFilePath exists and file is present
Display error message explaining why transcription failed
Tapping Retry sets status to 'processing' and calls transcription service
Follow same success/failure flow as auto-transcribe
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Delete audio file after successful transcription
userStories.description: As a user, I want audio files deleted after transcription succeeds to save disk space.
acceptanceCriteria: After transcription status set to 'completed', delete the audio file
Set audioFilePath to nil in database after deletion
Do NOT delete audio if status is 'failed' or 'pending'
Log if file deletion fails but don't block the flow
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Include transcriptions in AI analysis
userStories.description: As a user, I want my voice transcriptions included in daily AI analysis for comprehensive feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify AIAnalysisService to fetch recordings for the analysis date range
Only include recordings with status 'completed'
Add transcriptions to analysis prompt with header 'Voice Recording Transcriptions:'
Each transcription prefixed with timestamp
Update AI prompt to mention analyzing spoken English patterns
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Save recording on app termination
userStories.description: As a user, I want my recording saved if the app closes so I don't lose my audio.
acceptanceCriteria: Register for NSApplication.willTerminateNotification in VoiceRecordingService
If recording is active when app terminates, finalize and save audio file
Create database record with status 'pending' and valid audioFilePath
Ensure file write completes before termination proceeds
Typecheck/build passes

userStories.title: Recover interrupted recordings on app launch
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be notified of recovered recordings so I can transcribe them.
acceptanceCriteria: On app launch, query for recordings with status 'pending' and non-null audioFilePath
Verify audio file actually exists on disk
Show 'Transcribe' button on pending recordings in the list
Tapping 'Transcribe' triggers manual transcription flow
If audio file missing, update status to 'failed' with error 'Audio file not found'
Typecheck/build passes
